summary: Petrobras filed a 6-K announcing completion of its acquisition of a 49.99% equity interest in Lightsource bp's Brazilian subsidiaries, forming a renewable energy joint venture. The transaction, first disclosed December 16, 2025, closed after regulatory approvals. Lightsource bp contributed operational assets (Milagres solar PV plant, 212 MWp) and advanced-stage projects; Petrobras contributed engineering, licensing, and strategic direction. Governance is shared through equal board representation. No consideration, price per share, or premium disclosed. The deal aligns with Petrobras's 2026-2030 business plan to expand solar and renewable generation. Watch for operational integration milestones and project pipeline execution.
